 Order

This application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, 'Cr.P.C.') praying for the applicant to be granted anticipatory bail in FIR No.305/2023 registered at Police Station: Naraina, Delhi under Sections 498A/406/377/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (in short, 'IPC').
2.
The learned counsels for the applicant and the respondent no.2 submit that since the filing of the present application, the parties have amicably settled their disputes.
The respondent no.2, who is also present virtually, affirms the settlement.

3. In view of the same, it is directed that in the event of arrest in the above FIR, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.5,000/- with one local
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/04/2024 at 04:37:28 surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the IO/Arresting Officer/SHO concerned.
4. The Application is disposed of in the above terms.
